records.scope: The reference build. Proofs concern the analyzed AIR of this mode as recorded in the schema-12 profile. Native behaviour of this build is related to the model only by bounded differential tests and ABI probes; no backend preservation theorem.
records.premise: The theorem's Lean model is the ReleaseSafe analyzed AIR named in the generated profile header (PRF-02), with safety-checked illegal behaviour as Zig.Error (SEM-01). The exporter/translator fidelity (TRU-02) and LLVM lowering of the same source with -OReleaseSafe -mcpu=baseline (TRU-03) are trusted, supported only by golden comparisons and bounded native differential tests.

records.scope: Only the claim in README.md: a proof that a function never throws on given inputs implies its ReleaseFast build has no illegal behaviour on those inputs. No output, layout or performance correspondence is claimed, and no ReleaseFast AIR is translated.
records.premise: ReleaseFast compiles the same source as the ReleaseSafe reference build; it only removes safety checks, so it may diverge from ReleaseSafe only on executions with illegal behaviour. If the ReleaseSafe analyzed-AIR model (PRF-02, SEM-01) does not throw on an input, the source has no illegal behaviour on that input, provided Sema/export/translation (TRU-02) and LLVM lowering (TRU-03) are faithful. The premise excludes code under @setRuntimeSafety(false), @setFloatMode(.optimized), different CPU features or error tracing, and any differing comptime branch on @import("builtin").mode.
